item.title: Anna Karenina by Leo Tolstoy
item.description: The tragic story of a married aristocrat and her affair with Count Vronsky, set against 19th-century Russian society.

item.title: War and Peace by Leo Tolstoy
item.description: An epic tale following five aristocratic families through the French invasion of Russia, exploring themes of love, war, and human nature.
